shared_elements: repeated small figures/marks arranged in a horizontal row
horizontal registers stacked one above another
justification: The only real correspondence is the organisation of content into stacked horizontal registers of repeated, uniformly oriented units — schematic hull-and-crew-stroke boats in A, a marching file of helmeted men in B — which is a generic compositional habit rather than a shared motif. The depicted subjects differ entirely (vessels with stroke crews and abstract lines versus detailed human figures with pointed headgear, beards, garments and carried objects), and the rendering conventions are opposite: bare linear outline versus modelled figures with internal anatomical and costume detail.
